channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 28
item.description:
71 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
  • Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.

Combat

  • Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
  • Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.

Map & Loot Rooms

  • Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.

Base Building

  • Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
  • Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.

Animals & Wildlife

  • Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
  • Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
  • Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
  • Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

Economy & Vendors

  • Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.

Audio

  • Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 27
item.description:
18 development commits

Livestock & Animals

  • Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
  • Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
  • Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
  • Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

Structures

  • Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.
